en: "I was away for just a little while, and this happened!"{KP}"Who on earth could have done this... and in an instant!"{KP}"Otohime-sama's treasured {bb}Necklace{ww}, the priceless {bb}Blue Bell{ww}..."{KP}"How many treasures were stolen, I wonder?"{KP}"But for some reason, the {bb}Mirror of Truth{ww} alone was left untouched..."{KP}"There's a big hole over there, but to dig a hole like that in so little time..."{KP}"Could there be some kind of monster mole?"

jp:
「乙姫さまの　{bb}首かざり{ww}を
　取りもどして　いただいたそうで
　ありがとうございました！」{KP}
　
「でも　宝物を　盗んだ者は
　見つかっていないのですね…」
　{KP}
「あんな　大きな　穴を
　短時間で　ほれるなんて」
　{KP}
「絶対　化け物の　しわざに
　ちがいないと　思うのですが…」
en: "I hear you got back Otohime-sama's {bb}Necklace{ww}. Thank you so much!"{KP}"But the one who stole the treasures still hasn't been found..."{KP}"Digging a hole that big in so little time..."{KP}"It has to be the work of some monster, I'm sure of it..."

jp:
この　穴は　深くて
おりられそうに　ない……
en: This hole is deep. There's no way to climb down......
